deployment-commands.text: Deploy once with no second run, verify a node against the manifest, and attach all three journeys with exact spellings and an explicit duplicate refusal.

library-behaviour.text: Token derivation from the seed, identity comparison that rejects substitutions, hash-resolved references, quantity-one state location, pre-funding mirror check, tip-anchored retract, and polled confirmations.

attach-gate.text: Deploy once on a shared devnet, count, run all attached journeys, repeat the spelling for the refusal, then require both counters to rise on a fresh register.
